document: Personal identity document (ID card, social security card, passport, address card)
glossary: Document type: Personal identity document (ID card, social security card, passport, address card). Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_kind: the document kind as printed on the document (Okmany fajtaja: szemelyi_igazolvany | jogositvany | taj_kartya | lakcimkartya | adokartya | utlevel | kombinalt | egyeb)
field_specs.holder_name: the holder name as printed on the document (Az okmany tulajdonosanak neve)
field_specs.document_number: the document number as printed on the document (Okmany-azonosito szam (szemelyi szam NEM!), ha olvashato)
field_specs.valid_until: the valid until as printed on the document (Ervenyesseg vege, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, ha szerepel)
field_specs.birth_date: the birth date as printed on the document (Szuletesi datum, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, ha szerepel)
